commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' 2 - 1 Goal! Deniz Undav (Germany) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Felix Nmecha, then sends the ball low into the middle of the net. 2:1.

16' Nico Schlotterbeck (Germany) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
